module: Node "Race Config" (provider, tag input). Gives the configuration chosen by the player for the race, read once from scenario_scenarios.getScenario(): laps (scenario.lapCount), reverse (scenario.isReverse), rollingStart (scenario.rollingStart).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: As long as not done and a scenario exists, copies its settings to the pins.

onScenarioRestarted.desc: Restart hook: reads the configuration again.
